releases.title: v2.1.0 — self-updater, AI recs & animated TUI
releases.body:
## ame v2.1.0

A major release featuring integrated self-updating, personalized AI recommendations, dynamic live trending, YouTube Music-style related queue generation, music-themed animated loaders, and streamlined navigation.

### What's New

#### ⚡ Built-in Self-Updater
• **Command-Line Updates**: Update directly with `ame --update` or check for updates with `ame --update --check`.
• **In-App Keybinding**: Press `U` anywhere in the app to trigger an in-place update.
• **Silent Update Alerts**: Automatic non-intrusive notification toast informs you when an update is published on GitHub.
• **Reinstall Support**: Use `ame --update --force` to repair or clean-reinstall environment dependencies.

#### 🧠 AI Recommendations & Live Trending
• **Personalized Recommendations (`r`)**: Smart recommendation engine that generates dynamic music suggestions tailored to your saved favourites and playback history.
• **Live Trending Charts (`t`)**: Dynamically browse popular music with category cycling (`[` and `]`) across genres like *All Genres*, *Hip-Hop / Rap*, *Pop / Global Hits*, and more.
• **Instant Refresh (`u`)**: Fetch fresh trending and recommendation tracks on demand without restarting.

#### 📻 Smart Related Songs Queue
• Playing any track from **Search (`s`)** now automatically populates the **Queue (`q`)** with a curated list of related tracks and radio songs, just like YouTube Music.

#### 🌊 Animated TUI Loading & Refresh States
• Music-themed animated loader (`AnimatedLoader`) featuring animated equalizer waveform bars (` ▃▅▆▇▆▅▃ `), bouncing progress marquee, and brail

releases.title: v2.0.0 — ame rebrand
releases.body:
## ame v2.0.0

Rebranded from `ytmusic-tui` to **ame** (雨, "rain"), and removed Google
sign-in entirely.

### Rebrand
- App, launcher and repo are now `ame`; run with `./ame`.
- Class `AmeApp`, window title `ame`, theme CSS variables `$ame-*`.
- Repo moved to https://github.com/m7sh/ame (old URLs redirect).

### Removed
- All Google sign-in / OAuth / library code (`auth.py`, `ui/account.py`, the
  `g` and `6` bindings). Guest mode only — the reliable path.

### UI
- Theme-adaptive Matrix digital rain, shown only while audio is playing.
- First-letter view shortcuts (`t r m s q`); bottom key-hint bar removed.
- Terminal transparency retained (`ansi_default` backgrounds).

### Notes
- `cava` optional (visualizer); `mpv` + `yt-dlp` required.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ame/compare/v1.2.1...v2.0.0

releases.title: v1.2.1 — no more table scrollbar frame
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.2.1

Fixes the rectangle that appeared to surround the list. It was the DataTable's
own scrollbars, triggered by long YouTube titles making the table wider than
the window.

### Fixed
- **Scrollbars removed** from track/playlist tables and the moods list
  (`overflow-x: hidden`, zero-width scrollbars). Lists stay scrollable with
  `j`/`k`.
- **Columns now fit the window** — the title column takes the leftover width
  and `ARTIST`/`TIME` are capped, so long titles are clipped in place instead
  of pushing the other columns off-screen.
- **Resize-aware** — widths are recomputed on load and whenever the terminal
  is resized.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

releases.title: v1.2.0 — borderless chrome
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.2.0

Removes every box/line border for a cleaner, more modern look — separation now
comes from background tone and whitespace, the way cliamp does it.

### Changed
- **Top bar** — no bottom rule; it is a one-line panel band with a blank line
  beneath it.
- **Player bar** — no top rule; separated from the content by a blank line.
- **Moods split** — the vertical divider is gone, replaced by a whitespace gutter.
- **Search** — the rounded input box is now a full-width surface band that
  highlights on focus.
- **Help overlay** — borderless, on a lighter surface so it still stands out
  over the dimmed screen.

cl iamp's text dividers (`▸─ trending ──`) and the `━` seek bar are kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

releases.title: v1.1.0 — cliamp-inspired look + spectrum visualizer
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.1.0

A visual pass inspired by [cliamp](https://github.com/bjarneo/cliamp), plus a
real-time audio spectrum visualizer.

### Highlights
- **Letterspaced wordmark** `Y T M U S I C` and bracketed state chips.
- **Section dividers** in cliamp's style: `▸─ trending ── [2 songs] [1 chart] ──`.
- **Block volume meter** `VOL ██████░░ 80%` and a `[Q3]` queue chip in the top bar.
- **Spectrum visualizer** — [cava](https://github.com/karlstav/cava) taps the
  PipeWire monitor and drives fractional-block bars (`▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█`) with a
  green → yellow → red gradient. Hidden automatically when cava is missing.
- **Key-pill help bar** (`Esc back  Space play/pause  …`).
- **Status line**: `01:42 / 03:51  opus 160kbps  ▶ Playing` (`■ Stopped`,
  `⏸ Paused`, `◌ Buffering`), and a `STREAMING` seek bar for unknown durations.

### New bindings
- `v` show / hide the spectrum visualizer
- `h` show / hide the help bar

### Also
- Added the MIT `LICENSE` (Copyright © 2026 Mohammed Musharaf).
- New `spectrum.py` module and `Spectrum` / `SectionHeader` / `HelpBar` widgets.

### Requirements
- Python 3.11+, `mpv` and `yt-dlp` on `PATH`
- Optional: `cava` for the visualizer

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

releases.title: v1.0.0 — Minimal terminal-native redesign
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.0.0

First tagged release. A ground-up redesign of the interface around a spare,
terminal-native aesthetic.

### Highlights
- **One screen, no clutter** — sidebar, header badges and banners are gone.
  Views switch from a single tab line or with `1`–`5`.
- **Slim two-line player** — now-playing + time, then a full-width clickable
  Unicode seek bar.
- **Help on demand** — press `?` for the keybinding overlay instead of a
  permanent cheat sheet.
- **Live Omarchy theme sync** — the Omarchy palette is registered as a native
  Textual theme with CSS variables, so switching your desktop theme restyles
  the app instantly with no flicker and no stylesheet rewrites on disk.
- **No emoji, no noisy toasts** — plain Unicode rules, block glyphs and
  reverse-style selection.

### New bindings
- `A` queue every track in the current view
- `P` play every track in the current view
- `d` remove the highlighted track from the queue
- `?` toggle the keybinding overlay

### Fixes
- `esc` in the search box now returns focus to the results instead of
  re-focusing the input.

### Requirements
- Python 3.11+, `mpv` and `yt-dlp` on `PATH`
- `pip install -r requirements.txt`

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/commit/bd6d3aa

releases.title: v1.0.0 — Live-stream-safe YouTube ad skipper
releases.body:
First tagged release of **Omarchy Qutebrowser** — an aesthetic, keyboard-driven Qutebrowser setup with dynamic Omarchy theme synchronization and Wayland transparency.

## Features

- **Dynamic Omarchy theme sync** — hooks into `omarchy theme set` and updates all Qutebrowser colors live, without closing tabs.
- **Crystal-clear 0.90 transparency** — matches `foot` / `ghostty`, with a Hyprland window rule.
- **Local terminal startpage** — fast new-tab dashboard with clock, date, DuckDuckGo search and bookmarks.
- **Vim keyboard controls** — single-key navigation, hints, tab cycling.
- **1-key MPV playback** — press `M` on any video link to stream in hardware-accelerated `mpv`.
- **Built-in YouTube ad skipping** — bundled `greasemonkey/yt-ads.js`.

## Ad skipper notes

`greasemonkey/yt-ads.js` (v1.2.0) is now **live-stream safe**:

- Detects live streams via `ytp-live`, `.ytp-live-badge`, or a non-finite `video.duration`.
- **Never seeks live streams**, so they no longer jump to the end when an ad appears.
- Still fast-forwards finite ad clips to their end.
- Uses a `MutationObserver` + polling instead of the unreliable `load` event.

> Note: live streams that use server-side ad insertion cannot be skipped by seeking — the ad plays through, but the stream is no longer broken.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/m7sh/omarchy-qutebrowser.git /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser && /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser/install.sh && rm -rf /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser
```
